slot.brief: Locate the local maxima/minima of a cubic (or trig on an interval) using derivative sign change; ask the value of the function at the extremum.

stem: For $f(x)=x^3-6x^2+9x+2$, what is the value of $f$ at its local minimum?

verdicts.working: f'(x)=3(x-1)(x-3), so the local minimum occurs at x=3. Then f(3)=27-54+27+2=2.

working:
$f'(x)=3(x-1)(x-3)$.\nThe derivative changes from negative to positive at $x=3$, so the local minimum occurs there.\n$f(3)=27-54+27+2=2$.
